name: Crop
description: Crop/: Orientation (the eight EXIF orientations as a group: turn, flip, compose, the turned size and the unit-square matrix) and the OrientationTarget protocol; CropAspect (free, original, W:H, with Library's raw keys) and CropOrientation; CropFrame; CropRules (the largest frame of an aspect, a handle drag held to the aspect and the bounds, swap and nudge) and the CropTarget protocol; CropCommands (image.rotate-cw, -ccw, -180, image.flip and the five crop.* command specs). orientation-crop OC-1 declares them as stubs; OC-3 and OC-4 fill the bodies.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
